topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Found this raggedy bear at some yard sale, got to telling myself stories about how the world works. People, they stash away their yesterdays, thinking they're done with 'em. But ain't nothing ever really over. You turn a corner, and there it is, staring back at you, all fuzzy and worn, like a whisper from a long-gone river. Kid's toy shouldn't be able to kick up such dust in your mind, but it does. Makes you dig through the attic of your heart, unearthing ghosts thought long laid to rest. You clutch that bear, and it's not just a stuffed animal anymore. It's a key, maybe, to a door you didn't even know you kept locked.
